style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">2</span> The index bot regenerates index.json (path, sha1) for server, proxy and launcher, and commits it.<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">3</span> At pod start, the config-updater init container reads modList.json, index.json and storage/ from raw.githubusercontent.com (BASE_URL).<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">4</span> Nexus_Mods resolves each entry on api.curse.tools (and Modrinth, GitHub releases), then downloads missing or changed jars.<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">5</span> It writes /data: mods/, config/, kubejs/… and deletes every jar not in the list.<br><span style="background-color:#0f172a;color:#ffffff;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 4px;font-weight:bold;">6</span> The itzg server boots NeoForge 21.1.172 from /data, replacing ${CFG_*} placeholders with Secret values.</div></span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="310" width="900" #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">B</span> build_app.yml pushes config-updater only on tags updater-* (only updater-0.0.7 exists); the dotted link is the init container pulling :latest.<br><span style="border:1px solid #0f172a;color:#0f172a;border-radius:3px;padding:0px 3px;font-weight:bold;">C</span> electron-updater checks GitHub releases of the JSON_MOD_LIST_URL use Arffornia_Network, alive only through GitHub&#39;s redirect.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G8</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">Failed lookups delete mods.</font></b> Errors are logged, unresolved jars are deleted, exit code 0.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G9</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">No versioning.</font></b> main is production for everyone; jars on tag latest; images on :latest.<br><b><font color="#c2410c">G10</font></b> <b><font color="#0f172a">Third-party proxy.</font></b> CurseForge metadata from api.curse.tools, not the official API.<br><b><font Large dashed frame: infra perimeter · small: functional group
⚠ Gx: docs and code disagree, see "Gaps"

span.div:
1 A maintainer pushes to main of Arffornia_Provisioning: modList.json (CurseForge, Modrinth, GitHub entries) and storage/ files.
2 The index bot regenerates index.json (path, sha1) for server, proxy and launcher, and commits it.
3 At pod start, the config-updater init container reads modList.json, index.json and storage/ from raw.githubusercontent.com (BASE_URL).
4 Nexus_Mods resolves each entry on api.curse.tools (and Modrinth, GitHub releases), then downloads missing or changed jars.
5 It writes /data: mods/, config/, kubejs/… and deletes every jar not in the list.
6 The itzg server boots NeoForge 21.1.172 from /data, replacing ${CFG_*} placeholders with Secret values.

span.div:
A Mods and Proxy publish arffornia.jar and arffornia_proxy.jar on tags v*; modLists pin them to tag latest.
B build_app.yml pushes config-updater only on tags updater-* (only updater-0.0.7 exists); the dotted link is the init container pulling :latest.
C electron-updater checks GitHub releases of the launcher.
• On Play the launcher installs Java 21 from Azul and the NeoForge installer, syncs the launcher mod list into the game directory, then MCLC fetches Mojang files.

b.span: Gaps and risks found in code

span.div:
G7 Old repo URL. BASE_URL and JSON_MOD_LIST_URL use Arffornia_Network, alive only through GitHub's redirect.
G8 Failed lookups delete mods. Errors are logged, unresolved jars are deleted, exit code 0.
G9 No versioning. main is production for everyone; jars on tag latest; images on :latest.
G10 Third-party proxy. CurseForge metadata from api.curse.tools, not the official API.
G11 Unverified downloads. Java and NeoForge installer have no checksum.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
